chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman or someone else, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
In every ghusl there is wudu, except janabah.

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةَ: the state of major ritual impurity caused by janabah
key_terms.وُضُوءٌ: ritual ablution required for certain acts of worship

ai.seo_question: Is wudu required with every ghusl, or does ghusl al-janabah suffice by itself?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding ritual purification. It indicates that wudu accompanies every ghusl except the ghusl of janabah, which suffices on its own.
